subject: Pilot incentive request — credits + extension (Nascent Tech)
messages:
From: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@nascent.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nascent Tech Procurement <procurement@nascent.tech>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot proposal — credits + 60-day extension request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Nascent is excited about Redwood's inference performance for our feature backlog. We want to run a 90-day pilot focused on search relevancy and cost-per-query validation. To make the timeline feasible, procurement is asking for two concessions:

- $50k in platform credits applied to the pilot period (to cover peak runs)
- a 60-day extension window from trial end in case we need more evaluation time before committing

I've attached a short SOW that outlines the scope and measurement criteria (attachment: Nascent_Pilot_SOW.pdf). If Redwood can approve credits + the extension, we will aim to move to an initial 6-month commit within 30 days after the pilot.

Would love to confirm feasibility so we can get procurement moving.

Best,
Kara Simmons
Head of Platform, Nascent Tech
kara.simmons@nascent.tech
attachments: Nascent_Pilot_SOW.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@nascent.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal — credits + 60-day extension request

Hi Kara — great to meet you yesterday. Appreciate the clear SOW.

We can support a pilot like this but need to align internally on the credit amount and extension policy so we're not setting precedents that hurt unit economics. My read: we can get close to $45k in pilot credits if Nascent agrees to an opt-in 6-month minimal commitment after pilot or a usage-based floor. The 60-day extension is doable as a one-time concession for this program.

I've attached a quick pricing breakdown and a proposed mutual action plan (attachment: MVP_pricing_breakdown.xlsx).

Next steps from our side: I'll route this to RevOps and Marissa for exec-level approval to combine credits + extension. Can you confirm the expected start date for the pilot and the key success metrics? Procurement, please advise on EULA/PO timing.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Nascent pilot — ask for exec approval (credits + extension)

Marissa / Priyom,

Looping you in on Nascent's request (details above). Quick summary of the commercial ask:

- Pilot length: 90 days, expected start: Aug 2, 2027
- Requested credits: $50k (Nascent expects platform credits applied up-front)
- Requested extension: 60-day automatic extension
- Proposed Redwood concession: $45k credits + 60-day extension subject to 6-mo commit or minimum spend after pilot
- Upside: Nascent is strategic in our small enterprise pipeline and prioritizes inference at scale; potential expansion to multiple products if pilot passes

Impact/risks:
- Credits materially reduce near-term revenue but will accelerate ROI and increase likelihood of a 6-mo conversion
- Extension increases evaluation window; operationally we can flag metrics and re-evaluate SLA commitments if they extend beyond the pilot

Attached is a short concession calc I put together that shows blended ARR impact at different conversion rates (attachment: Concession_Calc.xlsx).

Asking for your exec sign-off or guidance on an approval path. If approved, I will update the OF with the credit line and extension clause and route to Legal/Finance.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nascent pilot — ask for exec approval (credits + extension)

+1 to moving — Nascent has a good reference profile and this is a high-propensity use case. Two asks before final sign-off:

1) Finance needs a clear recovery trigger (e.g., 6-mo commit or minimum spend) documented in the order form.
2) Product/Support should agree on an escalation path if they use burst capacity during pilot — this should not compromise our SLOs for other customers.

If Marissa can greenlight the $45k + extension with those conditions, I'll notify the CS lead to prepare the runbook.

Jonas

Team — after reviewing the case and the projected expansion profile, I approve the following exceptional concession for Nascent Tech (one-time approval):

1) Platform credits: $45,000 applied to the pilot (Nascent must sign the updated order form with line item for credits).
2) Trial extension: single 60-day extension allowed, must be requested in writing during the pilot and will be granted once.
3) Conversion requirement: Nascent must execute a minimum 6-month committed contract within 30 days of pilot completion OR agree to the clawback provisions (Finance to insert language).
4) Operational conditions: CS to provide a runbook; Product to confirm no SLA degradation for other customers during burst usage.

Ben — please update the order form to include the credit schedule, extension clause, and clawback. Loop in Legal Ops and Finance for final language and get the DocuSign sent to Kara and procurement.
